title: CriticDiff
description: Critic (Agent 8) output schema. Every correction must name the exact field, the specific issue, and the specific correction. Severity determines whether Rewriter handles it or logs only.

corrections.description: Surgical corrections only. Max 10. Prioritise by marks impact if more exist.

field.description: Exact field path e.g. definition, examples[0].steps[2].units_shown, rapid_revision.examiner_pattern

issue.description: Specific description of what is wrong — not generic

correction.description: Specific instruction for what to change — actionable
